summary: The idea you keep returning to may deserve a place in your actual life instead of remaining the thing you think about when everything else is finished.
body: The idea you keep returning to may deserve a place in your actual life instead of remaining the thing you think about when everything else is finished. When the Sun trines Neptune, imagination, compassion, creativity, or intuition can feel more connected to your sense of purpose, making it easier to recognize what genuinely inspires you rather than what merely looks impressive. Give the feeling enough form to become tangible, even if the first version is small. The point is not to make the dream grander; it is to stop treating something meaningful like it only belongs in your imagination.
